s: TCP/UDP, sockets, TLS, DNS internals, network debugging
d: Deep networking knowledge separates good backend devs from great ones. Understanding TCP internals, socket programming, TLS negotiation, and network debugging tools helps you diagnose production issues that others can't.
c: TCP handshake, congestion control, flow control
UDP & when to use it (gaming, streaming, DNS)
Network debugging: tcpdump wireshark netstat ss nslookup dig

p: Networking is a critical component of modern backend architecture. It focuses on optimizing performance, ensuring reliability, and scaling the system to handle increasing loads efficiently. Mastering this allows you to build enterprise-grade applications.
1. Understand the core principles and trade-offs.
2. Evaluate open-source tools and industry standards.
3. Implement the pattern within your backend stack.
4. Monitor performance and adjust configurations as scale increases.
